name: preview_capture
description: Review a bounded whole-pod Kubernetes status snapshot, selected Pod, impact and data handling. No collection; only pod-status/v1 can be collected by this runtime. Optional sharing shares the published result with up to eight users or groups of your identity provider (needs evidence-owner and the evidence:share scope; default 24 hours, at most seven days); get_capture reports sharing separately. Collect again: pass history_capture_id from list_capture_history (optionally with sharing) to restore its target and requested retention into a fresh preview with every current check. Plan a recording: profile_composition with one builtin profile (network-connections/v1 packet headers, syscall-activity/v1 syscall metadata) and typed overrides (pcap packetFilter, windows, ring, timeout, mode; onTrigger needs before 0s) returns its lifecycle plan, compiled filter and assessment. Recorders are not installed yet: such a preview has the RecorderUnavailable blocker and request_capture refuses it.

requested_retention_seconds.description: Requested evidence-access lifetime in seconds. Omission uses the administrator default; effective access and managed deletion remain bounded by current retention policy and its deletion budget. History restoration preserves its original request; use a normal edited preview to change it.

pod_selection.description: Selection for the fixed pod-status/v1 preset. This describes the reviewed pod, never ongoing monitoring coverage or authority to select a replacement.

d17.description: Pinned resolved profile. A builtin definition is embedded in the release binary (ADR-243) and is identified by its definition digest alone; organization and namespace definitions name their source cluster, namespace and object.

anchorRule.description: submissionPreparation measures from preparation of the first admitted submission: waiting counts and accepted retries retain the original registration. firstAcquisitionOrEarlierSource measures from acquisition or an earlier retained source.
